title: Feature Request Form
description: Have an idea that would make our product work better for you? Start with the problem you want to solve: understanding the need helps us find the best solution.

elements.name: requestSummary
elements.title: Summarize your request in one sentence

elements.name: productArea
elements.title: Which part of the product does this relate to?

elements.name: problemDescription
elements.title: What problem are you trying to solve?
elements.description: Describe what you are trying to accomplish and what makes it difficult today.

elements.name: problemFrequency
elements.title: How often do you run into this problem?

elements.name: workaroundStatus
elements.title: Do you currently have a way to work around this problem?

choices.text: No, I can't get it done
Yes, but it takes manual effort
Yes, I use another tool for it
Yes, and it works reasonably well

elements.name: proposedSolution
elements.title: How would you like this to work?
elements.description: Describe the ideal experience from your point of view. Sketch out the steps if that helps.

elements.name: successCriteria
elements.title: How would you know the problem is solved?
elements.description: For example, a task becomes faster, an error stops happening, or a report shows the data you need.

elements.name: importance
elements.title: How important is this feature to you?

elements.name: affectedUsers
elements.title: Who is affected by this problem?

elements.name: expectedBenefits
elements.title: What would this feature help you achieve?

choices.text: Meet a policy or compliance requirement

elements.name: isBlocker
elements.title: Is the lack of this feature preventing you from adopting or expanding your use of the product?

elements.name: followUpConsent
elements.title: May our product team contact you to learn more about your request?

elements.name: earlyAccessInterest
elements.title: Would you like to try an early version if we build this feature?

validators.text: Please enter a valid email address.

completedHtml:
Thank you for your request!

Our product team reviews every request and uses them to plan what to build next. Requests that describe the underlying problem are the easiest for us to act on, so thank you for taking the time.
